messages.text: I am reporting {name} for impersonation. When this user joined a Tandem party{when}, I saw that their profile uses photos of me, taken without my consent. Using someone else's pictures misleads other learners about who they are talking to and is a common way fake profiles are built. Please review the account and remove my photos.

{name} is using my photos on their profile without my permission. I noticed it when they spoke in a Tandem party{when}. This is impersonation: other learners believe they are talking to me, and fake profiles like this are often used for scams. Please remove the photos and review the account.

During a Tandem party{when}, I recognised my own photos on the profile of {name}. I never gave consent for my pictures to be used. This is identity theft, and it misleads the people in the room about who they are actually speaking with. Please take down the photos and investigate this profile.

Please review the profile of {name}. I saw it in a Tandem voice room{when}, and the profile pictures are photos of me, used without my consent. Impersonating a real person deceives other learners and is a typical first step in building a scam profile. I ask that the photos be removed and the account checked.

This report concerns {name}, who joined a Tandem party{when} with a profile showing pictures of me. I did not authorise this. Using my photos is impersonation, it misleads learners about who is behind the account, and it is how many fake profiles start. Please remove the images and take action on this account.

In a language party{when}, I came across {name}, whose profile uses my personal photos. These are pictures of me and I never agreed to their use. Presenting my face as their own is impersonation and leaves other learners unsure who they are really talking to. Please review the account and remove my photos.

While I was practising in a Tandem party{when}, I noticed that {name} has my photos on their profile. I am the person in those pictures and I did not consent. This kind of identity theft misleads other members and is often used to set up scam accounts. Please investigate and remove the profile or the photos.

Impersonation report: the account {name}, which I saw in a Tandem party{when}, uses photos of me without my consent. Other learners in the room may think they are speaking with me, and stolen photos are a common sign of a fake or scam profile. Please review this account and take the photos down.

The person using the name {name} has put my photos on their profile. I saw this{when} when they spoke in a Tandem party. I never gave permission, and using another person's pictures is impersonation that misleads learners and supports fake profiles. Please remove my photos and take appropriate action.

My photos are being used without my consent by {name}. I found out during a Tandem party{when}, when I opened their profile from the voice room. Pretending to be me misleads other learners about who they are talking to and is a known scam tactic. I am asking the moderation team to remove the photos and review the account.

I would like to report a case of identity theft. In a Tandem audio room{when}, {name} appeared with a profile that uses photos of me. I did not consent to this. It misleads the other participants and is how fake profiles are often built. Please review the account and remove these images.

{name} joined a Tandem party{when} using a profile with my pictures on it. Those photos are of me, and they are used without my consent. This is impersonation, and it gives other learners a false idea of who they are talking to. Please remove my photos and review whether this profile is genuine.

Please remove my photos from the profile of {name}. I saw the account in a Tandem party{when}, and the pictures on it are of me, used without permission. Someone is impersonating me on Tandem. The account {name}, which was active in a Tandem party{when}, uses my photos without my consent.
